3_safety_message_expanded_safety_message: Command emphasizes absolute safety of capping entry teams working under nighttime freezing conditions (28°F overnight). Enforce mandatory Level A PPE compliance and buddy system protocols. Heated decontamination water and warm hydration must be maintained continuously to prevent suit icing and hypothermia.
